The kit's arc rotation values (for example `A 76,76 15 …` on the chain) suggest each part's stored rotation. I used them as hints to restore the turning parts.

**Frame** (stays at 0°)
- The rear dropout eyelet centre is at about (38.75, 365.3).
- The head tube top edge is (615.5, 18.5)–(647, 9.5). Its centre is about (631.3, 14) and it slopes about −16°.
- The head tube bottom edge is (644.5, 115)–(678, 105), with centre (661.25, 110).
- The seat tube top edge is (236.5, 57.5)–(255, 52.5), with centre (245.75, 55), sloping −15.1°.

**Drivetrain**
- The chain's rear arc centre is (44.61, 28.94) and its front semicircle centre is (328.12, 155.04).
- Rotating the chain −15° about the rear hub puts its front centre at about (345.2, 413.7). That is where the seat tube and down tube axes meet, so it is the bottom bracket.
- The chainring centre (81.22, 81.03) goes on that point.
- The crank eye (20.09, 138.64) also goes on that point.
- The crank's outer end (≈19.25, 13.6) lands at (344.4, 288.7), and the pedal axle (21.76, 35.17) goes there.
- The cassette centre (52.37, 52.41) goes on the rear hub.

**Front end**
- The fork crown centre (27.62, 5.91) sits on the head tube bottom centre.
- The fork tip hub is estimated at (44.65, 286.5).
- I chose a fork rotation of −21.27° so the front hub lands at y = 365.3, level with the rear hub. This also leaves the crown edge roughly flush with the head tube.
- The front wheel then goes at (778.9, 365.3).
- The handlebar spacer's bottom edge is centred at about (18.2, 57.4) and slopes +15°. Rotating −31° makes it flush with the head tube top edge.

**Saddle**
- The collar's bottom edge is centred at about (174.7, 150.4) and slopes about −39.3°.
- Rotating +24.5° makes it flush with the seat tube top edge.

**Canvas fit**
- Everything is wrapped in a translate(280, 117) group so the whole bike fits on the 1376 × 768 canvas.

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1376 768">
  <g transform="translate(280,117)">
    <use href="#kit-rear_wheel" transform="translate(-219.55,107)"/>
    <use href="#kit-front_wheel" transform="translate(520.61,106.99)"/>
    <use href="#kit-fork" transform="translate(661.25,110) rotate(-21.27) translate(-27.62,-5.91)"/>
    <use href="#kit-frame"/>
    <use href="#kit-cassette" transform="translate(-13.62,312.89)"/>
    <use href="#kit-chainring" transform="translate(264.02,332.69)"/>
    <use href="#kit-chain" transform="translate(38.75,365.3) rotate(-15) translate(-44.609,-28.937)"/>
    <use href="#kit-crank" transform="translate(325.15,275.08)"/>
    <use href="#kit-pedal" transform="translate(322.64,253.535)"/>
    <use href="#kit-handlebar" transform="translate(631.4,13.3) rotate(-31) translate(-18.2,-57.4)"/>
    <use href="#kit-saddle" transform="translate(245.75,55) rotate(24.5) translate(-174.7,-150.4)"/>
  </g>
</svg>
```
